scope.basis: The original 20261124 SOURCE_MANIFEST-pinned LogExtension before the separate lossless constant/profile extraction. This is the heavy actual-source dependency handoff, not a census of the new lightweight analytic targets.
not_traced: new derivative/profile/physical modules being handled separately

locators: 607-620: complete fifth region and bad equality wall
1090-1101: fixed finite family before N tends to infinity

selection_policy: Use the explicit Gamma5 manifest pins for the target, ArithmeticGeometry, and P4BSmoothGateUpperStep.
For each other reached project module, prefer the existing active source; otherwise select the unique byte identity among reached same-basename archive candidates.
Do not replace a source merely because another tree has the same basename; compare its recorded SHA-256 and provenance.
Six exact P1 repair alternatives are recorded separately; they are not silently applied to the baseline source graph.
Existing live qualified sources or objects must be compared against these hashes and their dependency signatures before staging or reuse.
